children: co-founder Tony Fernandes said on Friday that the low-cost carrier's challenges from soaring jet fuel costs were "far, far" less severe than those it faced during the COVID-19 pandemic period.
Speaking at a media briefing, he also said strong demand for air travel continued to support the business.
